title: RV & Boat Storage Rental Terms — Notice to Vacate, Move-Out and Return of Deposits
content:
**Notice to vacate.** Notice to vacate an RV & Boat Storage space is the renter's own act and must give at least the notice-to-vacate number of calendar days set for the space class; a vacate date sooner than that is moved to the end of the notice period. Once notice is given the rental is under notice to vacate, with the vacate date on record.

*Hypothetical cases, with notice given on 5 June and a 10-day notice period (the period therefore ends on 15 June):*

| Vacate date stated | At least the notice period? | Vacate date that applies |
|---|---|---|
| 12 June | no | 15 June, the end of the notice period |
| 15 June | yes | 15 June |
| 20 June | yes | 20 June |

**Withdrawing notice.** A notice may be withdrawn before the vacate date. Withdrawal returns the rental to active and clears the vacate date.

**Rent in the final month.** Rent for the month of the vacate date is due in full.

**Move-out.** On the vacate date the unit is removed and the space surrendered, and the rental is closed as of that date.

**Cleanout.** When debris or property is left in the space at move-out, the cleanout fee of the space class is charged and taken from the security deposit.

**Security deposit.** The security deposit is applied to any balance owed and the rest refunded within the deposit refund period, counted in calendar days from move-out. The refund is the deposits held for the rental (deposits collected, less deposits already applied or refunded), less the balance owed on the rental (rent, electric hookup fees, late fees and one-time fees, less payments and credits), where a balance owed below zero counts as zero; the refund is never below zero.

*Worked figures (hypothetical inputs):*

| Security deposit held | Balance owed on the rental at move-out | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| 75.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 |
| 75.00 | 30.00 | 45.00 |
| 75.00 | 90.00 | 0.00 |
| 75.00 | a credit of 10.00 (below zero) | 75.00 |
| 100.00 | 100.00 cleanout fee, nothing else owed | 0.00 |

**Reservation deposit.** A reservation deposit is applied to rent at move-in, refunded on a timely cancellation, or forfeited.

**End of the site lease.** When the site lease ends, the storage rental must also end, because storage is for residents only.
